added.member: UI documents: <input type="date">, time, datetime-local, month, week
added.summary: A pad-friendly picker of og-ui steppers, one per part, bound by value in HTML's format, within min and max and on the step grid from min; a part past its end carries into the next. Required or out-of-range values are :invalid and hold a form's submit back. Before this they were refused.
Whole digits shown zero-padded and ungrouped (a clock's 05, a year's 2026); 0 keeps thousands grouping.
